resources.string: Offer to set up automatic archival renewal after extending

The extension to B-LT failed because revocation information (CRL/OCSP) could not be obtained. You can continue with a B-T extension (signature timestamp only, without revocation data), or abort and try again later.

This document carries validation data, but none of it can be used: it was issued after the signing certificate expired, and an issuer no longer vouches for a certificate once that has happened. Unless the issuer publishes data that explicitly covers expired certificates, nothing newer can replace it and the document will not reach B-LT. An archival timestamp preserves what is there; it does not close the gap.

The document was extended, but the revocation data the requested level needs could not be embedded, so it stayed at its previous level. You can save the result anyway, or abort and keep the original document.

The document was extended and keeps its level, but the issuer has published no revocation data newer than the signature, so nothing was embedded that the document did not already carry. Saving keeps the result; extending again before the time named below will achieve just as little.
